title: Use one Windows native-path strategy for backup abandonment without directory canonicalization
outcome: Use one Windows native-path strategy for backup abandonment without directory canonicalization
acceptance: The library abandonment path and CLI backup path share an explicitly justified Windows long-path conversion that does not require filesystem canonicalization solely for path spelling; deterministic relative, already-verbatim and long-path coverage preserves no-clobber publication and logical diagnostics.
